title: Patch: the account screen fills or drops its empty "This season" heading, shows the rank crest, and keeps match history's tap areas apart
thread:
**Issue #3957 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3957: Patch: the account screen fills or drops its empty "This season" heading, shows the rank crest, and keeps match history's tap areas apart
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

A follow-up to the account screen (#3733, merged in #3861), found in its device-size screenshots. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

- **Overview, every size over 600 px:** the "This season" heading has nothing under it; "All time" follows at once. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3733-account/account-1280x720-desktop.png))
- **Header, and the Play hub's Online cards (#3729), every size:** the rank crest beside "Raisin" is nearly invisible, a dark outline on a dark ground. ([account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3733-account/account-1280x720-desktop.png), [Play hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3729-play-inbox/play-1280x720-desktop.png))
- **Match history, iPad sizes:** the full-width "All replays" link's tap area covers the last row's "Watch replay".
- **Match history, 820 and 744:** each row's date wraps onto a second line.

All 14 shots: https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3861#issuecomment-6892235451.

### What should happen

At every device size in #3726: "This season" shows this season's record when there is one, and is left out when there is none (as the ranked line already does, `account.test.tsx` around line 421). The rank crest reads clearly on the dark ground wherever it is drawn. No tap area covers another control. A history row's date stays on one line at 820 and 744, or the row lays out so a wrap reads cleanly.

### Where

`apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, `accountSections.ts`, `account.css`; the crest is `apps/web/src/rank/RankCrest.tsx` and `rankCrest.css`, shared with `apps/web/src/routes/PlayHub.tsx`.

### Tests

Cases that fail without the fix: in `apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx`, a player with no games this season sees no "This season" heading, and one with games sees it with their record. For the tap areas, a check in the spec that renders the account screen at `MENU_SIZES` (spec 47's `hitAreaProblems` or an overlap check). Keep the existing account tests passing.

I'll take the device-size screenshots for the pull request once it merges.
```
